build.pdf.failedKept: The build of revision {{n}} failed. The PDF below is revision {{kept}}.
build.pdf.failedNone: The build of revision {{n}} failed; there is no PDF yet.
build.pdf.noneReason: The manuscript has no successful build yet. Press Build PDF in the toolbar to make a preview.
build.pdf.noViewer: The browser cannot show the PDF here. Use Export › PDF to download it.
build.log.noneReason: Press Build PDF to compile the current revision; results and errors show here.

build.log.loadFailed: Could not load the raw log
build.export.oldTitle: The PDF is not the current revision
build.export.oldBody: The PDF is revision {{pdf}}; the current revision is {{current}}.

build.export.oldArchived: The project is archived, so it cannot be built; you can still download this PDF.
build.export.noneBody: The manuscript has no successful build yet. Build the PDF first, or download the source (zip).
build.issue.text.unbalanced_braces: A { or } is missing or extra. Check the brace pairs around the reported line.
build.issue.text.undefined_control_seque: The command {{command}} is not defined. Check the spelling or load the package that defines it.
build.issue.text.missing_file: {{path}} was not found. Fix the path or add the file to the manuscript.
build.issue.text.missing_package: The package {{package}} is not loaded or not in the build’s TeX Live. Fix the line that loads it or remove what uses it.
build.issue.text.missing_package_command: {{command}} needs the package {{package}}, which is not loaded or not in the build’s TeX Live. Load it in the preamble or remove the command.
build.issue.text.undefined_citation: The key {{key}} is not in the bibliography. Pick a key from the citation suggestions or add a Trusted Reference to the project.
build.issue.text.shell_escape_disabled: {{command}} needs shell escape, which builds do not run. Use a way that does not need it.
build.issue.text.path_outside_manuscript: The build does not read {{path}} because it is outside the manuscript. Add the file to the manuscript and use a relative path.
build.issue.text.timeout: The build stopped after {{limit}} seconds. Reduce the size of the document or figures and build again.
build.issue.text.memory_limit: The build reached the {{limit}} MB memory limit of the build environment. Reduce figure sizes or split the document.
build.issue.text.memory_limit_tex: TeX ran out of its internal capacity. Check for runaway macros or very large tables.
build.issue.text.infrastructure_unavaila: The system could not provide a build environment. Try Build PDF again later; the manuscript is not affected.
build.issue.general.unbalanced_braces: A { or } is missing or extra. Check the brace pairs around the reported line.
build.issue.general.undefined_control_se: A command is not defined. Check the spelling or load the package that defines it.
build.issue.general.missing_file: A file used by \input, \include or \includegraphics was not found. Fix the path or add the file.
build.issue.general.missing_package: A package is not loaded or not in the build’s TeX Live.
build.issue.general.undefined_citation: A citation key is not in the bibliography.
build.issue.general.shell_escape_disable: A command needs shell escape, which builds do not run.
build.issue.general.path_outside_manuscr: The build does not read files outside the manuscript.
build.issue.general.timeout: The build took too long. Reduce the size of the document or figures and build again.
build.issue.general.memory_limit: The build exceeded the memory limit. Reduce figure sizes or split the document.
